effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_effect.des: Nfa ihamọra apaniyan ati aabo bypassing bibajẹ lori akoko. Ti o ba jẹ nipasẹ Soul Sorcerer, ṣe adehun ibajẹ ti o da lori ipin ti o da lori ilera ibi-afẹde ti o pọju.
effect.ibarnorigins.casting_soul_firebal: Soul Sorcerers 'ọkàn fireball agbara. Ina a ọkàn fireball lori ipa ipinnu.
effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_strength_e: Ṣe alekun ibajẹ melee nipasẹ 50% ni ipele 1 ati 100% ni ipele 2.
effect.ibarnorigins.fire_weakness_effect: Ṣe alekun ibajẹ lati awọn orisun ina nipasẹ 100%.
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soul_burn.play: Ọkàn %1$s jo lọ lakoko ti o n gbiyanju lati sa fun %2$s
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast: %1$s jẹ vaporized nipasẹ agbara ọkàn ti o ni idojukọ
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast.play: %1$s jẹ vaporized nipasẹ agbara ọkàn ti o ni idojukọ lakoko ti o n gbiyanju lati sa fun %2$s
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.name: Ghaster
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.description: Awọn arọmọdọmọ ti awọn Ghasts ti a gbala lati Nether ati awọn ti o di eniyan diẹ sii nitori ifihan gigun wọn si Ikọja.
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.name: Eniyan Iyanrin
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.description: Awọn eniyan Iyanrin jẹ eniyan ti iyanrin ti o ngbe inu iyanrin.
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.name: Oṣó ọkàn
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.descript: Ipin-ije ti eniyan ti o ni anfani lati ṣe ikanni agbara ẹmi wọn.
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.name: Gbẹ ibinu
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.descr: Amalgamates idaji-undead idaji-undead ti o di idasi ayeraye pẹlu awọn agbara gbigbẹ nitori abajade awọn idapọ pẹlu awọn ohun kohun gbigbẹ.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.name: Ailagbara Physique
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.descri: Botilẹjẹpe o di diẹ sii ni ibamu si Overworld, o jẹ alailagbara ti ara, okuta mi rọra diẹ, ṣe adehun 25% dinku ibajẹ melee, ati pe o le rẹwẹsi ni iyara.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.name: Fireball Instantiation
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.descr: Botilẹjẹpe o ti fi ara rẹ han si Overworld, o ti ni idaduro agbara ina-bọọlu pataki ti awọn baba rẹ, si iwọn kan o kere ju.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.name: Ifowopamọ
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.descri: Nlọ lakoko ti o yọkuro yoo jẹ ki o fa soke ki o leefofo soke fun igba diẹ.
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.name: Ki Resistance
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.descripti: O ni kan to lagbara resistance si idan bibajẹ.
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.name: Ọkàn iná rogodo
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.description: Gba agbara si bọọlu ina ti n jo ẹmi pataki ti o pọ si ni agbara bi ipele iriri rẹ ti dide (ti o ga julọ ni ipele 100).
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_attributes.de: Mu ipalara ti o dinku nigbati o ba duro lori awọn bulọọki iyanrin ṣugbọn nikan ṣe 50% ti ibajẹ nigbati o ba wa ni ohunkohun miiran ju iyanrin lọ. Ni afikun, o yoo nigbagbogbo spawn ni a asale.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.name: Iyanrin Burrowing
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.desc: O le sin ara rẹ sinu iyanrin. Nigba ti burrowed ti o ba wa alaihan.
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.name: Iyara ọkàn
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.descriptio: Agbara ọkàn ni iyanrin ọkàn ati ile ẹmi gba ọ laaye lati rin irin-ajo ni iyara.
power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.des: Ṣe afikun 50% iye ibajẹ lakoko ti o duro nitosi awọn orisun ina tabi dani awọn ohun kan mu. Pẹlupẹlu, iduro taara inu ina ọkàn yoo ṣe alekun awọn ikọlu melee si ibajẹ afikun 100% ati 50% afikun ibajẹ bọọlu ina ọkàn.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_fireweakness: Botilẹjẹpe o lero pe o dara nitosi ina ẹmi, ina gbigbo deede lati awọn ògùṣọ ati awọn ina ibudó ni ipa ailagbara to lagbara lori rẹ. Bii iru bẹẹ, o tun gba afikun 100% ibajẹ diẹ sii lati ina ati ki o fọ afọju lori gbigbe bibajẹ ina.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_piglinfear.d: Iná ẹmi akọkọ ti n jó ninu rẹ nfi ibẹru sinu gbogbo ṣugbọn awọn Piglin ti o ni igboya julọ.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.d: Eran ko ni agbara ẹmi pupọ bi awọn ẹfọ ṣe. Nipa eyi eran ko ṣe atilẹyin fun pupọ ṣugbọn awọn ẹfọ funni ni iriri lori jijẹ ti o da lori bii wọn ṣe kun.
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.name: Homing Wither Skull
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.descripti: Ṣe ikanni awọn ipa ti undead ati conjure awọn agbọn ti o gbẹ ti o wa awọn ọta rẹ.
power.ibarnorigins.wp_item_prevention.de: O ko le wọ eyikeyi ihamọra ti o ga ju ihamọra irin.
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.name: Ofurufu
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.description: Ara rẹ jẹ imọlẹ pupọ ati pe o lagbara lati wẹ nipasẹ afẹfẹ.
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.name: Alailagbara
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.description: Nitori idapọ rẹ, ara rẹ di alailagbara pupọ (awọn ọkan 5) ati pe o ko le ṣe awopọ pupọ ibajẹ melee aise.
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.name: Awọn ikọlu gbigbẹ
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.description: Pẹlu lilu kọọkan o fa ipa ti o gbẹ lori awọn ọta rẹ.
